raw_text: CERT-In Advisory CIAD-2024-0052: A state-sponsored APT group has attempted to compromise the Defence Research and Development Organisation's internal network through a supply chain attack targeting a third-party IT vendor. Custom malware was deployed through a compromised software update mechanism. All defence and research organizations are advised to audit third-party vendor access, verify software update integrity, and implement application whitelisting on critical systems.
clean_text: CERT-In advisory on DRDO supply chain attack via compromised vendor. All defence organizations advised to audit vendor access, verify update integrity, and implement application whitelisting.
